behavior: The coordination policy assigned Robot 0 the HOLD role throughout the experiment while preserving its observation, map and odometry provenance in the shared system.
Robot 1 explored long-range frontier B, recovered from one locally unreachable continuation, then progressed through bounded safe approaches toward frontiers C and A.
A second locally unreachable approach was isolated at source step 124; the next safe rounds moved Robot 1 out of that region rather than repeating the failed target.
At source step 249 the fused semantic map produced a five-cell plant region from a potted-plant detection with confidence 0.851619.
Robot 1 followed the semantic-region target, reported LOCAL_PLANNER_ARRIVED after 19.152683 m, and stopped with zero velocity.
The terminal RGB shows the plant and white planter at close range in the central field of view, and the onsite operator confirmed physical success.
The terminal batch placed both robots in HOLD and the cleanup disabled further Hub GOAL output while preserving read-only observation, maps and Foxglove.
